lessons.title: Negotiation Foundations
lessons.content: Negotiation reaches agreement between parties with differing interests. It's not winning against the other side — it's creating and claiming value. KEY CONCEPTS: Win-win beats win-lose for lasting deals. Every negotiation has interests (why) beneath positions (what). WORKED EXAMPLE: Two people want an orange — one needs juice, one needs peel. Positions clash; interests don't. PRACTICE: 1) List your interests in a real negotiation. 2) Guess the other side's interests. 3) Find a creative trade.
